features: 【Immersive Sleep Experience & Hi-Fi Sound】Designed exclusively for quiet personal listening, this speaker offers gentle volume to protect hearing and avoid disturbing partners. Enjoy immersive sound without wearing anything in your ears, and without worrying about disturbing family members around you. Enjoy your favorite music in complete comfort. (Note: Due to its design for under-pillow use, the volume is typically low.)

【Portable Bluetooth Speakers Wireless】Effortlessly pair with your favorite devices using advanced Bluetooth 5.4 technology. This bluetooth pillow speaker ensures fast, stable wireless connections for uninterrupted soothing audio throughout the night .With rich stereo effects and a convenient auto-shutdown timer, enjoy meditation or sleep music peacefully—no external sound leakage.

【White Noise Machine for Healthy Sleep】This pillow speaker for sleeping is a sleep aid music box designed to improve sleep. It features multiple built-in sleep-inducing sound effects to help you and your children fall asleep more easily. It's great for both adult and children's sleep. Whether for daytime naps or nighttime sleep, it improves sleep quality for healthier sleep.

【Ultra-Thin, Lightweight & Comfortable Design】Crafted from ABS+PC and soft polyester fabric, this bone conduction under pillow speaker measures just 9.6cm in diameter and 1.1cm thick. At only 48g, it’s lightweight, discreet, and comfortably fits under any pillow without causing discomfort. Connect your phone and adjust the volume to your liking, then place the speaker under your pillow to enjoy audio content only you can hear, without disturbing your sleep partner.

【Long Battery Life】 This portable bluetooth speaker has a built-in 300mAh battery, providing up to 20 hours of continuous use on a single charge. Enjoy a longer, more comfortable music experience. Set a sleep timer for 30, 60, or 90 minutes, and the sleep speaker will automatically turn off, eliminating the need to get up in the middle of the night. The integrated Type-C port supports 5V/1A fast charging, keeping your under pillow speaker ready whenever you need soothing sleep sounds.
